detailMarkdown:
# HeyClaude Skill Submission Factory

Create portable Agent Skills, generate platform adapters, validate package metadata, and prepare PR-first HeyClaude submissions.

## Trust
- Source: source-backed
- Package: maintainer-built/verified package
- Review: unclaimed

## Safety notes
- The install command downloads a HeyClaude-hosted skill archive and unzips it into the current working directory.
- Review generated skill packages and submission fields before opening a PR; the skill does not publish content by itself.

## Privacy notes
- Skill drafting may include public source URLs, package metadata, and compatibility notes.
- Do not include credentials, private repository details, customer data, or unpublished material in generated skill packages or submission drafts.

## Install
```bash
curl -L https://heyclau.de/downloads/skills/heyclaude-skill-submission-factory.zip -o heyclaude-skill-submission-factory.zip && unzip -o heyclaude-skill-submission-factory.zip -d ./heyclaude-skill-submission-factory
```

## Usage
Use this skill when creating a portable Agent Skill and submitting it to the HeyClaude skills registry.
